title: Air France Doubles Morocco Flights for Summer 2026 — Daily Marrakech-Paris Service Now Live
body:
Air France now operates daily flights on the Paris CDG-Marrakech route, with twice-daily service on peak Fridays and Sundays. The expansion adds approximately 2,400 additional seats per week between France and Morocco compared to Summer 2025.

Booking Tips

Fares are 15-25% higher than 2025. Tuesday-Thursday departures offer better value. Business Class remains available at competitive premiums. All Air France Morocco routes include complimentary meals even on short flights.

Source: Air France commercial announcement via Kech24.
